name: viz
description: The data-visualisation maths layer (ADR 0023): pure functions that turn numbers into numbers and SVG path strings — extent, a linear scale that draws a flat series as a level line, evenly spaced series points inside a plot's insets, line and area paths, columns that always stand on zero with their data end rounded and negatives hanging below it, and Intl number formatting. Every coordinate is rounded to two decimals so server and client write identical paths. Imports no maths module yet; d3 modules are admitted behind this file when a chart needs band or time scales, and never reach a public signature.
